lines.zh: 我摆动鳍肢，在暖海里缓慢滑行。
lines.en: I sweep my flippers and glide through the warm sea.

lines.zh: 巨壳拖着水，我走得比看上去快。
lines.en: My huge shell drags water, yet I move faster than I look.

lines.zh: 深海的沙被我拍起一层白雾。
lines.en: My flippers kick the deep sand into a pale cloud.

lines.zh: 我不敢快，壳太重，转弯也慢。
lines.en: I dare not hurry; my shell is heavy and turns slowly.

lines.zh: 温水推着我，像推一块老石头。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me along like an old boulder.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚上方绕开，怕碰坏它们。
lines.en: I swing around the coral so I do not break it.

lines.zh: 鳍肢一下一下，海底的路很长。
lines.en: Stroke by stroke, the seafloor road is long.

lines.zh: 我浮上水面吸一口气，再沉下去。
lines.en: I rise to breathe, then sink back down.

lines.zh: 壳上的藤壶跟着我一起晃。
lines.en: The barnacles on my shell sway as I go.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖流走，那里水不冷。
lines.en: I follow the warm current, where the water stays kind.

lines.zh: 两只鳍一起划，我才推得动自己。
lines.en: Both flippers must row before I move at all.

lines.zh: 水草擦过腹甲，痒得我偏了方向。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my belly plate and I veer off.

lines.zh: 我不追谁，只是慢慢地挪过去。
lines.en: I chase no one; I simply drift that way.

lines.zh: 深海很暗，我凭水流认路。
lines.en: The deep is dark, so I read the currents.

lines.zh: 我驮着人，速度还是这样。
lines.en: With a rider I still move this slowly.

lines.zh: 暖流一拐弯，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: The warm current bends; so do I.

lines.zh: 我嚼着海草，嚼得很慢。
lines.en: I chew seagrass at a slow pace.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，落在我壳上。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the surface and lands on my shell.

lines.zh: 我闭眼听水母漂过去的声音。
lines.en: I close my eyes and hear jellyfish drift by.

lines.zh: 老壳上又多了几枚藤壶。
lines.en: A few more barnacles have settled on my old shell.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像海底的一块岩。
lines.en: I hold still as a rock on the seafloor.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进壳里，打个长盹。
lines.en: I pull my head in and take a long nap.

lines.zh: 温水深海安静，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: The warm deep is quiet but for my breathing.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼在我壳下躲阴影。
lines.en: A small fish hides in my shell's shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬鳍赶走爬在脖子上的小虾。
lines.en: I flick a shrimp off my neck.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的呼吸，一次很久。
lines.en: I count my breaths; each one lasts ages.

lines.zh: 海流换了方向，我懒得动。
lines.en: The current has turned, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里泡着，壳都松了。
lines.en: I soak in the warm water until my shell loosens.

lines.zh: 远处传来鲸歌，我听着不动。
lines.en: Whale song carries from afar; I listen without moving.

lines.zh: 我把鳍摊开，让鱼清理甲缝。
lines.en: I spread my flippers for fish to clean the seams.

lines.zh: 你潜得挺深，胆子也不小。
lines.en: You dive deep, and you are bold.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转眼看你，脖子有点僵。
lines.en: I turn my slow eye on you; my neck is stiff.

lines.zh: 你在我壳边显得很小。
lines.en: You look small beside my shell.

lines.zh: 你不像河豚，我不躲你。
lines.en: You are no pufferfish, so I will not hide.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸壳，我先缩了头。
lines.en: You reach for my shell; I pull my head in first.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，你在水里看我。
lines.en: I watch you in the water; you watch me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我背上，凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my back, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我认得呼吸声，你的太快了。
lines.en: I know breath sounds, and yours is far too quick.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，踩到我的鳍了。
lines.en: You stand too close; you are on my flipper.

lines.zh: 老龟看人，向来要看好久。
lines.en: An old turtle takes a long time to judge a person.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一点，我听得见。
lines.en: I hear the small crack in my shell.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了道缝，海水正往里渗。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell; seawater seeps in.

lines.zh: 我缩头，把弱点藏起来。
lines.en: I pull my head in and hide the weak spot.

lines.zh: 六十点血，不是白长的。
lines.en: Sixty points of life were not grown for nothing.

lines.zh: 你打的是壳，不是肉。
lines.en: You struck shell, not flesh.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，先躲一躲。
lines.en: I sink deeper to hide for a while.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的鳍发麻。
lines.en: That blow left my flipper numb.

lines.zh: 老龟也会疼，只是不喊。
lines.en: Old turtles feel pain too; we just do not cry.

lines.zh: 壳上的白痕又多一道。
lines.en: One more pale scar on the shell.

lines.zh: 谁再打我，我会记住的。
lines.en: Whoever strikes me again will be remembered.

lines.zh: 热带鱼的味道，我隔着水闻到了。
lines.en: I smell tropical fish through the water.

lines.zh: 河豚别乱晃，那刺我认得。
lines.en: Do not wave that pufferfish; I know those spines.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼在动，我看见了。
lines.en: That fish in your hand is moving; I see it.

lines.zh: 我从深海浮上来，就为这一口。
lines.en: I surfaced from the deep just for this bite.

lines.zh: 五十四格东西，不差一条鱼的地方。
lines.en: Fifty-four slots of cargo, and room for one fish.

lines.zh: 鱼别丢太远，我游得慢。
lines.en: Do not throw the fish far; I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 你的鱼比海草香多了。
lines.en: Your fish smells far better than seagrass.

lines.zh: 我张嘴了，别把手指也递过来。
lines.en: My mouth is open; do not offer a finger too.

lines.zh: 河豚有刺，我还是想吃。
lines.en: The pufferfish has spines, and I still want it.

lines.zh: 为了繁殖，我得吃够这些鱼。
lines.en: To breed, I must eat my fill of these fish.

lines.zh: 撞我等于撞一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: Bumping me is bumping a moving wall.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的膝盖还好吗。
lines.en: My shell is hard; how is your knee?

lines.zh: 你顶不动我，我六十点血。
lines.en: You cannot shove me; I have sixty points of life.

lines.zh: 慢点，那么大的壳不会让路。
lines.en: Easy, a shell this big does not give way.

lines.zh: 你贴着我壳走，蹭出白印了。
lines.en: You rub along my shell and leave a pale mark.

lines.zh: 水下撞一下，声音闷得很。
lines.en: A bump underwater sounds muffled and deep.

lines.zh: 我转身要一圈，撞到别怪我。
lines.en: Turning takes a full circle; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 你别站在我鳍后面。
lines.en: Do not stand behind my flippers.

lines.zh: 这一下把海底沙都撞起来了。
lines.en: That knock lifted sand off the seafloor.

lines.zh: 壳上多了划痕，我不介意。
lines.en: Another scratch on the shell; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我叼着热带鱼，在暖水里等你。
lines.en: I carry a tropical fish and wait in warm water.

lines.zh: 河豚是聘礼，别嫌它扎嘴。
lines.en: The pufferfish is my gift; forgive its spines.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此游，绕得很慢。
lines.en: We circle each other, very slowly.

lines.zh: 沙地要挖浅坑，卵才放得稳。
lines.en: I scoop a shallow nest so the eggs sit safe.

lines.zh: 老龟求偶，不看年纪看壳纹。
lines.en: Old turtles court by shell patterns, not age.

lines.zh: 你游得比我快，那就等等我。
lines.en: You swim faster than I do, so wait for me.

lines.zh: 我把鳍搭上去，这就够了。
lines.en: I rest a flipper on you, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 深海没什么见证者，只有水母。
lines.en: Few witness us here, only drifting jellyfish.

lines.zh: 这一季的鱼够肥，卵会结实。
lines.en: The fish are fat this season; the eggs will be firm.

lines.zh: 别急，交配要等暖流过来。
lines.en: Be patient; mating waits for the warm current.

lines.zh: 我用鳍夹起东西，笨手笨脚的。
lines.en: I pinch things with my flippers, clumsily.

lines.zh: 五十四格，鱼和贝壳都塞得下。
lines.en: Fifty-four slots hold fish and shells alike.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳我捡了，你换一个。
lines.en: I am taking this shell; find another.

lines.zh: 鳍太短，小东西总漏下去。
lines.en: My flippers are short, and small things slip.

lines.zh: 我可以帮你驮着，别放太重。
lines.en: I can carry it, but do not load me too heavy.

lines.zh: 河豚我先收着，等交配再用。
lines.en: I keep the pufferfish for the courtship later.

lines.zh: 我低头拱起这块沉木。
lines.en: I lower my head and lift this sunken log.

lines.zh: 在深海里捡东西，得摸黑找。
lines.en: Picking things up in the deep means groping blindly.

lines.zh: 这堆鱼我驮得动，别再加了。
lines.en: I can haul this pile of fish, no more.

lines.zh: 掉的东西我先看，不问来路。
lines.en: I inspect what dropped and ask no questions.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃我的后鳍。
lines.en: Something is nibbling at my rear flipper.

lines.zh: 那条鱼咬着藤壶，不太对劲。
lines.en: That fish is biting my barnacles, and it is wrong.

lines.zh: 我转头了，但可能只是海草。
lines.en: I turn my head, though it may be only seagrass.

lines.zh: 谁在水里撞我壳，我记住了。
lines.en: Whoever rammed my shell, I have noted it.

lines.zh: 不是敌人，只是靠太近了。
lines.en: Not an enemy, just far too close.

lines.zh: 我六点攻击不多，也够用。
lines.en: My six points of attack are few, but enough.

lines.zh: 沉船里跳出个影子，我盯住了。
lines.en: A shadow leaps from the wreck, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 你身后那条鱼一直跟着。
lines.en: That fish behind you has been following.

lines.zh: 深海没有主人可护，只护自己。
lines.en: In the deep I guard no master, only myself.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，先看清再说。
lines.en: I turn slowly and look before I act.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，壳里的心跳很慢。
lines.en: I fix on it, my heart slow inside the shell.

lines.zh: 六点的喙，咬下去也疼。
lines.en: Six points of beak still bite hard.

lines.zh: 它一退，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: When it backs off, I creep one step forward.

lines.zh: 老龟不急，等的就是破绽。
lines.en: Old turtles wait for the opening.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压住它。
lines.en: My shadow presses down on it first.

lines.zh: 它游不出这片暖水。
lines.en: It will not swim out of this warm water.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让它先动。
lines.en: I open my beak and let it move first.

lines.zh: 壳挡在中间，它咬不到肉。
lines.en: The shell is between us; it cannot reach flesh.

lines.zh: 我瞄准鳍根，那里软。
lines.en: I aim at the base of its fin, where it is soft.

lines.zh: 别催，我出手一向很慢。
lines.en: Do not rush me; my strikes are always slow.

lines.zh: 喙一合，骨头发出闷响。
lines.en: My beak closes with a muffled crunch.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，对巨龟已算重。
lines.en: Six points is heavy for a giant turtle.

lines.zh: 我咬住鳍，把它往沙里按。
lines.en: I bite its fin and press it into the sand.

lines.zh: 三百斤的壳压过去，躲不开。
lines.en: Three hundred pounds of shell cannot be dodged.

lines.zh: 它撞我壳，我回它一口。
lines.en: It strikes my shell; I return one bite.

lines.zh: 水里动作慢，咬上了就狠。
lines.en: Slow in water, but vicious once I connect.

lines.zh: 这一口为后鳍的疼。
lines.en: This bite is for my aching flipper.

lines.zh: 我的鳍比你的船桨大。
lines.en: My flipper is bigger than your oar.

lines.zh: 咬完我就退，懒得追。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat; chasing is too much work.

lines.zh: 沙里翻起的血，很快散了。
lines.en: The blood in the sand disperses quickly.

lines.zh: 我从温水深海浮起来，第一次呼吸。
lines.en: I rise from the warm deep for my first breath.

lines.zh: 这片海够暖，我就在这落壳。
lines.en: This sea is warm enough, so here I settle.

lines.zh: 沙底留下我爬过的长沟。
lines.en: A long groove trails behind me in the sand.

lines.zh: 我壳上还带着深海的凉。
lines.en: The chill of the deep still clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 罕见的事：巨龟在这片海露面。
lines.en: Rare indeed: a giant turtle shows in this sea.

lines.zh: 我慢慢睁开眼，看见蓝色的光。
lines.en: I open my eyes slowly to blue light.

lines.zh: 水母绕着我转，像在认新邻居。
lines.en: Jellyfish circle me as if greeting a neighbor.

lines.zh: 我的鳍第一次拍在沙上。
lines.en: My flippers strike sand for the first time.

lines.zh: 这片暖海以后归我慢慢走。
lines.en: This warm sea is mine to cross slowly.

lines.zh: 我出生时壳就很大了。
lines.en: My shell was already huge when I was born.

lines.zh: 热水烫壳，我往下沉。
lines.en: Hot water scalds my shell; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我这副甲壳，落地先弯一下。
lines.en: This shell bends first on landing.

lines.zh: 我本该会游，怎么喘不上气。
lines.en: I should be able to swim; why can I not breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，肚甲朝天。
lines.en: The blast flipped me, belly plate to the sky.

lines.zh: 箭插在壳缝里，扎得深。
lines.en: An arrow sticks deep in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳里，凉得发疼。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my shell, cold and aching.

lines.zh: 海草吃完了，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: The seagrass is gone and I feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我壳都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning reaches into the sea and lights my shell.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳍在乱划。
lines.en: No water in the void; my flippers flail.
